data.name: Aerathiel
data.description:
In the ancient annals of Current's genesis, the villagers remained oblivious to Fujin's unleashed fury within the valleys. But as raging tempests laid waste to their crops and made life a daily struggle, they erected an altar to appease Fujin's wrath, offering sacrifices for mercy. Though momentarily effective, peace proved short-lived.

 

On a fateful afternoon, children playing near the sacred altar accidentally desecrated it, reigniting Fujin's wrath. Hurricane-force winds tore through the village, reducing even the altar to rubble. Amidst the chaos, a young member of the Aerathiel lineage emerged. With unwavering determination, she faced the storm, her skin lashed by winds like a whip. Carrying a heavy stone from the ruined altar, she planted it where it once stood, offering her life for her people's salvation. Fujin, moved by her selfless devotion, softened, transforming the hurricane into a gentle breeze. Legend has it that Aerathiel descendants inherit divine mastery of the wind element, from destructive gusts to soothing melodies in wind chimes.

data.name: Windshear Decay
data.description: Razor sharp wind slashes that leave lasting and decaying effects
data.battleDescription: %user forms a series of intricate hand seals which summons forth the power of the winds that once quelled Fujin's fury. With a swift motion, they unleash a torrent of razor-sharp wind slashes that tear through the air towards %target. The wind howls with a vengeful fury, and as the invisible blades connect, they slice deep into %target's flesh, leaving behind festering wounds. The air around %target grows heavy with the scent of decay as the slashes begin to fester and deepen over time, continuing to tear at their flesh with each passing moment.

data.name: Death's March
data.description: Release waves of chakra that strikes your target
data.battleDescription: %user envelops %target in a radiant chakra tunnel.  They unleash an unyielding wave of chakra, targeting their enemy's cells with relentless precision. As the assault subsides, the enemy's once-sturdy form crumbles, consumed by decay.

data.name: Atomic Shield
data.description: Create a barrier of particles to protect you
data.battleDescription: %user creates a translucent barrier made of the particles around them to defend from all attacks

data.name: Decaying Touch
data.description: Touch your target and start to destroy their body through a dusty decay.
data.battleDescription: %user creates a dust cloud that surrounds %target. Dashing through the cloud, they appear in front of %target, placing their hand on them. %target slashes at %user, and their body becomes dust. Only after the dust has disappeared does %target realize that the part of their body that was touched is beginning to decay.

data.name: Particle Cannon
data.description: The ultimate power comes with the ultimate price.
data.battleDescription: %user weaves an intricate triangle with their fingers, bringing forth a radiant orb that caresses %user's hand with a warm glow that both energizes and burns. Gradually, the sphere transforms, unfurling into a brilliant beam, propelled with purpose towards %target

data.name: Night Parade of A Thousand Demons
data.description: Long ago a small village was under threat of destruction. Sandwiched between 3 warring nations, each sought to claim the village as their own and demanded the chief swear loyalty to them. However, the chief knew that swearing loyalty to any one would spell destruction as the other two would surely attack. Secretly, he tasked his only daughter to go find help, but no one wanted to get involved and risk war from the 3 powerful nations. So, she turned to the only place she could, the underworld. She began making summoning contracts with smaller lesser powerful beasts, collecting allies until she had enough strength to recruit more powerful entities. And when she was finally done, she had amassed a force nearing a thousand. 999 Demons had made a contract with her, offering up a portion of their power. When the deadline came for the village chief to swear loyalty, his daughter returned with her new found power and struck down the ambassadors of each nation. Normally, this would mean eradication, however, she had become so powerful that she was able to take on the forces of all 3 nations with her summoned demons. When the dust cleared, all 3 nations were no more and that small village had annexed them all. Unfortunately, however, the village chief's daughter had to pay the ultimate price. By overusing the powers granted to her, she had, tragically, become a demon herself. The village chief had to seal her and her army away into his own granddaughter. With time and many wars, the village eventually was destroyed and the seal gradually weakened. Now on the night of a lunar eclipse, the moon tinted blood red, the seal finally broke and the Night Parade begins.
